# Several comparable items in the material carry a comparison

## Statement
Where the material treats several comparable items the same way, a strategy
that compares them gives the reader more than one that follows a single item
through. Not yet validated against the client's own published work.

## Applies when
always

## Influences
- S-09 · `E-13.reader_path` — which candidate strategy survives selection.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
A fixture record for the Knowledge Maintenance job: a record inside the warning
